The Datalabs Agency designs the world’s most beautiful and effective Tableau dashboards.

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=””][vc_column]

We, the Datalabs Agency, are...

Tableau Dashboard Designers That Will Change The Way Your Business Does Analytics & Reporting

[vc_column_text]Business intelligence dashboards or BI dashboards from visual analytics designed in software like Tableau are replacing Microsoft Excel. That’s because business intelligence dashboards foster quicker, more insightful decisions. Employees have the data at their fingers. And not always just at their desks.

Sales meetings can focus on visualized data by regions, by teams, and by-products. Imagine this: your business’ analytics in real-time, anywhere in the world with an internet or mobile connection, receiving up-to-the-minute data on key insights – whether it’s sales, sign-ups, or purchases. This is the new norm.

If you’d like to see a Tableau Reporting Project, click here. If you’d like to see a dashboard case study, click here.[/vc_column_text]

Want To Know If We Can Help?
Speak To DatalabsSpeak To Datalabs

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=”” force_equal_height_columns=”main_row” mobile_destroy_equal_heights_resolution=”1023″ dfd_row_config=”full_width_content” dfd_row_responsive_enable=”dfd-row-responsive-enable” css=”.vc_custom_1533646932953{padding-right: 10% !important;padding-left: 10% !important;}” responsive_styles=”padding_left_desktop:30|padding_right_desktop:30|padding_left_tablet:30|padding_right_tablet:30|padding_left_mobile:20|padding_right_mobile:20″ mobile_destroy_equal_heights=”yes”][vc_column width=”1/2″ dfd_column_responsive_enable=”dfd-column-responsive-enable” css=”.vc_custom_1533647015184{padding-right: 5% !important;}” el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ offset=”vc_col-lg-6 vc_col-md-6 vc_col-xs-12″ responsive_styles=”padding_right_tablet:10|padding_right_mobile:10″]

Beauty, brains, and functionality...

The Best Tableau Dashboard Designers for Operational, Tactical, & Strategic Data

[vc_column_text]A vital component of any data-driven culture, well-designed dashboards streamline and democratize business-critical data. There’s no gatekeeper. Those that are assigned access to the dashboards receive the data. No longer is there a sole entity or personality controlling the flow and communication of your data. That kind of transparency fosters a culture of accountability that smart businesses thrive on.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″ el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ offset=”vc_col-lg-6 vc_col-md-6 vc_col-xs-12″]

New dashboards & retrofitted ones...

Tableau Dashboard Designers & Developers

[vc_column_text css=””]

Datalabs’ dashboard developers work with some of the best analytics dashboard software available, but we’re experts in Tableau dashboard design and development. Are you interested in discovering what business intelligence dashboard tools can do for your business?  Are looking for a Tableau dashboard designer, or want to have a consultant work with your team to develop visual ideas? Or, if you need Tableau dashboard design training, we can help.

[/vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_enable_overlay=””][vc_column]

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″ dfd_column_responsive_enable=”dfd-column-responsive-enable” css=”.vc_custom_1533647027694{padding-left: 5% !important;}” el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ offset=”vc_col-lg-6 vc_col-md-6 vc_col-xs-12″ responsive_styles=”padding_left_tablet:10|padding_left_mobile:10″]

User experience is vital...

Why Choose the Datalabs Agency as Your Tableau Dashboard Designer?

[vc_column_text]Datalabs designs dashboards with a methodology and unique process. We start with the audience for your dashboard. We really want to know who’s going to use your dashboard. And how they’re going to use it. Where they’re going to use it. At their desk? On a mobile device with a client>

Then a whiteboard session can get all stakeholders in a room and on one page. Internally, we’ll create paper prototype designs. Soon we’ll quickly a visual reporting style unique to your business and help solve your visual reporting problems.

We design dashboards that focus attention on key elements, business drivers, actionable outcomes, and all the business jargon a PwC or Accenture can throw at you. At the Datalabs Agency, we’re looking to visualize the ability of your audience to make big decisions with the data you have. Let’s start by simplifying your data and organizing your Tableau reporting for you.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_bg_style=”canvas”][vc_column]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″]

Learn the fundamentals and advance to the next level.

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″]

Present data like an expert, tell stories like a pro.

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″]

Designing Great Dashboards

Learn a better way to design dashboards, no matter the software.

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″]

The Best Training Workshops

See the type of team training we do.

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]

[vc_column_text]If you like what you see, click the button below to start the conversation about how Datalabs can make your Tableau dashboard that looks amazing, simplifies your reporting, and becomes the focus of a data-driven, visual organization.

Contact our development team to give you and your employees beautiful dashboards, ones that you’ll love looking at every day.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″ el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ offset=”vc_col-lg-6 vc_col-md-6 vc_col-xs-12″]
